text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the school store one day, I
notice
they've set up a special section
I've not seen
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheerfully gazing up at the banner
bearing the
words "Grand Opening!" is...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Superb! Such splendid workmanship! I'm
sure the
trainers will be absolutely
thrilled to see this!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're already here, Trainer

<username>?!
Perfect timing!
Look closely!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: We've set up a new space within the store specifically for trainers! And today is the grand opening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa points with great
intensity to a
sign that says...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! It offers a wide range of
convenient,
hand-picked, high-quality
"training items"!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Make good use of them to ensure your
trainee's
healthy development!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I listen in wonder as Director Akikawa
joyfully
explains the different products
that are available.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...And to top it all off, money is
unnecessary!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! At this shop, you procure
goods by
exchanging special coins!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! These coins are
awarded based
on race performances!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This all sounds far too good to be true. I
gather
my resolve and ask point-blank.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: D-Director?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well if it isn't Tazuna! I was just giving
Trainer
here a rundown of the Pro Shop.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This shop is exactly what I'm here to
discuss!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Director... You used your pocket money
to go on
a massive shopping spree
again, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Verily! I'm funding all of this out of my
own
pockets!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And I've already established all my
supply routes!
Expeditious!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but can't you
ever do
things in moderation?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! No amount of money is too
great
when it's spent on helping my
beloved students!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait! This discussion isn't over!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm here to do some fieldwork for
another
story. I thank the academy for
its continued
cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But I must say—this is amazing! Director Akikawa is willing to devote all of her personal funds to the students!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I simply must write an article on her!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Director Akikawa resolves to give all
she has for
the Twinkle Star Climax!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "And Trainer will sacrifice everything to help realize her hopes!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: How did it get to the point where I'm giving up everything too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gaze out the window as I listen to
Reporter
Otonashi chatter excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I really am grateful to have access to the
Pro Shop, though. I need to take
advantage of every
option available to
me!
